subject: animated broccoli pursuit

source_quote: the broccoli was my best bet. It took off like a shot towards the apothecary, that place with all the magical potions and stuff.

subject: animated food incident
fact: During the feast on Planting 22, 579, ingredients including broccoli and potatoes became animated and fled into the village, causing chaos. The broccoli headed toward the apothecary, and the potatoes were later captured and consumed. This event was linked to the Black Earth Cult’s influence.
source_quote: some of the ingredients were animated and they rushed into the village... Bouncing potatoes... It’s just bouncin, bouncin, bouncin on down the road...

subject: animated ingredients flee

source_quote: some of the ingredients were animated and they rushed into the village

subject: animated potato ambush
fact: Three animated potatoes, one of which was stabbed and the others stunned, were captured and later consumed in a honey-glazed forest stew.
source_quote: Bouncing potatoes,” I shout to Seqoia and run after them. The potatoes stare at me as if taunting me. I grab one, and the other two pause as if angry. So I take my knife and stab the one in my hand. The other two potatoes are stunned.

subject: Black Earth chant revelation
fact: Surviving guards reported that the attackers chanted ‘Black Earth’ and carried weapons of stone, linking the assault to the cult.
source_quote: The guards who survived said that the attackers chanted ‘Black Earth’ and carried weapons of stone.

subject: broccoli animated

source_quote: It took off like a shot towards the apothecary

fact: A broccoli, previously considered mundane, was revealed as an animated object capable of independent movement and direction toward the apothecary.
source_quote: I figured the broccoli was my best bet. It took off like a shot towards the apothecary, that place with all the magical potions and stuff. Honestly, I wasn't quite sure what to do. Part of me thought, "Let it go, it's just a broccoli."

source_quote: I roll, and I can’t remember if I hit, but yes, I do and it just kind of collapses.

subject: Calmer

source_quote: Calmer shouts, "Magic was used here, or something very big. This isn’t just a bunch of brigands."

subject: calmer’s failed bluff
fact: Calmer attempted to bluff the cultists by claiming to be lost, but the druid Thalsor immediately recognized them as intruders and denounced their presence.

subject: caravan ambush cause
fact: The caravan ambush was not caused by bandits, but by magical cultists wielding stone weapons and chanting ‘Black Earth,’ as confirmed by surviving guards and magical residue.
source_quote: The guards who survived said that the attackers chanted ‘Black Earth’ and carried weapons of stone. … Calmer shouts, “Magic was used here, or something very big. This isn’t just a bunch of brigands.”

subject: caravan attack
fact: The caravan was ambushed on the road near the Kron Hills. Wagons were overturned, barrels broken, and honey jars scattered. Magic was used, evidenced by glowing runes and large footprints. Survivors reported attackers chanting 'Black Earth' and wielding stone weapons, indicating a cult attack rather than banditry.
source_quote: The ground is churned up... Magic was used here... faintly glowing runes etched into the rocks... chanted 'Black Earth' and carried weapons of stone.

subject: caravan attacked
fact: The caravan was attacked and did not take the standard road.
source_quote: They didn’t take the standard road, the fools.

subject: cultist armor description
fact: The cultists wore stone-studded leather armor and carried stone weapons, indicating ritualistic devotion to earth and stone.
source_quote: The guardian are wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons.

subject: cultist identification
fact: Cultists wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons were identified as the perpetrators of the caravan ambush and guardians of the stolen honey.
source_quote: The guardian are wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons. … I whisper, “These are the guys.”

subject: cultist negotiation attempt
fact: Thalsor attempted to negotiate during combat, offering trade in exchange for the honey, but refused to surrender it.
source_quote: Then, Thalsor he brings out something else. … Weird guy. Offers to trade, anything but giving up the honey.

subject: cultist retreat confirmation
fact: All surviving guards who witnessed the attack have since left the town, preventing direct interrogation.
source_quote: they have all since left our town.

subject: falling rocks
fact: The party almost got crushed by falling rocks while following the trail.
source_quote: we almost get crushed by falling rocks.

subject: final battle outcome
fact: The party engaged in a chaotic, multi-phase battle against Thalsor, his mud men, the stone golem, and cultist minions, ultimately surviving but not yet defeating the cultists.
source_quote: Things are far from over.

source_quote: Glannon looks at the barrel.

subject: honey-glazed forest stew

source_quote: And a few hours later, the potato is in my belly. And I feel blessed. The honey-glazed forest stew feels like a blessing indeed.

subject: honey theft motive
fact: The stolen honey was claimed by the Black Earth Temple as tribute to the Earth Mother, not mere plunder.
source_quote: That honey now belongs to the Black Earth Temple, a tribute to her enduring might.

subject: infiltration of Black Earth Cult encampment
fact: The party infiltrated the hidden encampment in the Kron Hills using a split strategy: Calmer attempted a bluff at the gate while Zinnia, Zephyr, and Sequoia scaled the wall. Calmer’s ruse failed as Thalsor denounced them for desecrating sacred ground. The encampment contained barrels of honey, a stone temple, and stone-wielding cultists.
source_quote: We've just gotten over the wall... Calmer tries to bluff these bandits... Thalsor... starts shouting about the earth mother... Inside the walls is a temple... as well the barrels that we are looking for.

subject: Lareth’s target identification
fact: The Black Earth Cult is identified as the target Lareth wants killed, likely due to their possession of a box he seeks.
source_quote: This might be the clue and evidence we need. It certainly is who Lareth wants us to kill, and they might have this box that Lareth wants.

subject: Kron Hills encampment
fact: A hidden cultist encampment built into a shallow cave on a rocky outcrop in the Kron Hills, guarded by stone-armored cultists with stone weapons. Contains a temple with a stone statue and the stolen honey barrels. The site is concealed and protected by natural defenses, including suspicious falling rocks.
source_quote: It’s built into a shallow cave on a rocky outcrop... guarded gate with makeshift stone barricades... stone-studded leather armor... temple to some god, a weird stone statue... the barrels that we are looking for.

subject: Kron Hills trail
fact: A trail leading into the Kron Hills, easily followed but nearly blocked by falling rocks suspected to be magically directed, ends at the hidden cult encampment.
source_quote: The trail into the Kron Hills is easy to follow. Although along the way, we almost get crushed by falling rocks. I am worried that the stones were not an accident, but we find nothing.

subject: Kron Hills trail
fact: The trail into the Kron Hills is easy to follow, with falling rocks that may not have been accidental.
source_quote: The trail into the Kron Hills is easy to follow. Although along the way, we almost get crushed by falling rocks. I am worried that the stones were not an accident, but we find nothing.

subject: Sheernobb
fact: Sheernobb is the home of Palsmarie Clee, the beekeeper druid, referenced as the origin of her title.
source_quote: The beekeeper druid of Sheernobb is very quiet.

subject: temple to some god
fact: Inside the encampment is a temple to some god, featuring a weird stone statue.
source_quote: Inside the walls is a temple to some god, a weird stone statue, as well the barrels that we are looking for.

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: bandits
fact: A group of bandits are present at the start of the encounter and are swiftly eliminated by Sequoia and Zinnia with flurry attacks. They are wounded and killed in quick succession.
source_quote: Sequoia just goes to town on one of the bandits... Zinnia follows, just laying into the bandits... the bandits are dropping like flies.

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: mud men
fact: Mud men explode when defeated, creating an area that impedes movement.
source_quote: when these mud men go down, they kind of explode, make it so you can’t move.

subject: mud men
fact: Two mud men appear beside Calmer during the battle. They are unnatural creatures that explode upon death, creating area-of-effect immobilization effects. They are defeated early in the conflict.
source_quote: Suddenly two muddy creatures appear right beside Calmer. Mud men... When these mud men go down, they kind of explode, make it so you can’t move.

subject: stone golem
fact: A stone golem is summoned by Thalsor when he taps a stone object. It is large, highly resistant to non-magical damage, and remains a persistent threat throughout the battle despite taking heavy damage from Calmer’s holy spell.
source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam! – it comes alive. Stone Golem, they call it. Big, tough, and resistant to everything but magical attacks.

subject: stone golem
fact: Thalsor summoned a stone golem that is resistant to non-magical attacks.
source_quote: he taps this stone thing and – bam – it comes alive. Stone Golem, they call it. Big, tough, and resistant to everything but magical attacks.

subject: stone-studded leather armor wearers
fact: Guardians at the encampment wear stone-studded leather armor and carry stone weapons.
source_quote: The guardian are wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a cleric who heals, identifies magical activity, and attempts to bluff Thalsor, which backfires.
source_quote: Calmer shouts, "Magic was used here, or something very big. This isn’t just a bunch of brigands." ... Calmer tries to bluff these bandits–or whatever they are–about being lost, but it’s backfiring something fierce.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a combatant who uses a holy spell to damage the stone golem, leads intimidation attempts against Thalsor, and is actively engaged in the battle against the druid and his constructs.
source_quote: Calmer hits it with some kind of holy spell, deals a ton of damage... Calmer leads the charge with that...

subject: Glannon
fact: Glannon is the tavern keeper who offers mead and later admits he may have been mocking the visitor about charisma.
source_quote: He realizes his mistake, "No, I didn’t mean it that way. The magic in the mead will help when you need to interact with people and persuade them. Drink a mug, and you’ll turn the heads of those you are attracted to, convince a merchant to cut a better deal, and in general be more persuasive. I know of one bard who drinks some before a performance and gets better tips."

subject: Glannon
fact: Glannon rolls the barrel behind the bar.
source_quote: He rolls the barrel behind the bar

subject: Gnonsbim
fact: Gnonsbim claims the attackers were bandits, contradicting survivor accounts of chanting and stone weapons.
source_quote: Gnonsbim says they are bandits. I don’t think so. The guards who survived said that the attackers chanted ‘Black Earth’ and carried weapons of stone.

subject: Gnonsbim
fact: Gnonsbim claims the attackers were bandits.
source_quote: Gnonsbim says they are bandits.

subject: Lareth
fact: Lareth wants the party to kill the Black Earth Cultists and retrieve a box they may possess.
source_quote: This might be the clue and evidence we need. It certainly is who Lareth wants us to kill, and they might have this box that Lareth wants.

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee coughs while sitting quietly in the Honey Tavern Inn.
source_quote: Palsmarie Clee coughs. The beekeeper druid of Sheernobb is very quiet.

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee shows Zephyr a map indicating where the caravan was attacked.
source_quote: Let me show you on the map where the caravan was.

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee, the beekeeper druid of Sheernobb, appeared silently in the Honey Tavern Inn and provided critical intelligence about the caravan attack, identifying the attackers as chanting 'Black Earth' and wielding stone weapons. She directed the party to the attack site and urged them to investigate.
source_quote: Let me show you on the map where the caravan was... The guards who survived said that the attackers chanted 'Black Earth' and carried weapons of stone.

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee, the beekeeper druid of Sheernobb, appears silently in the inn and provides a map and warning about the caravan's disappearance.
source_quote: As I put the last bit of food in my mouth, Palsmarie Clee coughs. The beekeeper druid of Sheernobb is very quiet. "Let me show you on the map where the caravan was. They didn’t take the standard road, the fools. Go there, follow the bandits, and get the honey."

subject: Quinna Poul
fact: Quinna Poul rushed out of the kitchen to enlist help retrieving animated food ingredients from the village feast, specifically a runaway broccoli that headed toward the apothecary. She was both smiling and worried, and the party felt obligated to assist after the previous feast.
source_quote: So - remember that feast, well some of the ingredients were animated and they rushed into the village. Could I bother you to go get them?

subject: Quinna Poul
fact: Quinna Poul rushes out of the kitchen and asks for help retrieving animated ingredients from the village, specifically broccoli.
source_quote: Quinna Poul comes rushing out of the kitchen as I saunter into the first floor dining area. "So - remember that feast, well some of the ingredients were animated and they rushed into the village. Could I bother you to go get them?"

subject: Quinna Poul
fact: Quinna Poul rushes out of the kitchen when Sequoia enters the dining area.
source_quote: Quinna Poul comes rushing out of the kitchen as I saunter into the first floor dining area.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia engages in combat with cultists, lands flurry of attacks on bandits, and directly targets Thalsor.
source_quote: Sequoia just goes to town on one of the bandits—absolute flurry of attacks. ... Sequoia’s still hacking away at Thalsor, getting some tough blows in.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is a rogue who initiates aggressive attacks on bandits and Thalsor, lands multiple critical hits, and is the primary combatant pressing the assault on Thalsor during the final stages of the battle.
source_quote: Sequoia just goes to town on one of the bandits—absolute flurry of attacks... Sequoia’s still hacking away at Thalsor, getting some good hits in.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia said, "Sometimes a rock is a falling rock."
source_quote: "Sometimes a rock is a falling rock," I say.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia thought, "It’s just the life, I guess. Never a dull moment."
source_quote: It’s just the life, I guess. Never a dull moment.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor is a druid of the Black Earth Temple who speaks of the Earth Mother, summons mud men, and commands a stone golem.
source_quote: Thalsor of the Stone fellow, some kind of druid, starts shouting about the earth mother and how we're trampling on sacred ground. ... Thalsor raises his staff, and the runes on the walls flare with an ominous light. ... Suddenly two muddy creatures appear right beside Calmer. Mud men. ... He taps this stone thing and – bam! – it comes alive. Stone Golem.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor is a druid who leads the encampment and speaks of the Earth Mother.
source_quote: This Thalsor of the Stone fellow, some kind of druid, starts shouting about the earth mother

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor is a druid who wields a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals, commands mud men and a stone golem, and seeks to protect the honey of the Black Earth Temple. He is hostile, manipulative, and capable of conjuring storms of sharp stones and negotiating under duress.
source_quote: Thalsor rumbles something about stone, and suddenly two muddy creatures appear... He taps this stone thing and – bam! – it comes alive. Stone Golem... He conjures up a storm of sharp stones.

subject: Thalsor of the Stone
fact: Thalsor of the Stone is a druid affiliated with the Black Earth Cult who guards the encampment in the Kron Hills. He rejected Calmer’s bluff, invoked the Earth Mother, and accused the party of trampling sacred ground, confirming the cult’s religious devotion to stone and earth.
source_quote: He’s shouting about the earth mother and how we're trampling on sacred ground. He’s not buying what Calmer’s selling.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr attacks animated potatoes, carries them in a bag, consumes one, and participates in the assault on the cult encampment.
source_quote: I grab one, and the other two pause as if angry. So I take my knife and stab the one in my hand. ... I grab them and stuff them into a bag. ... And a few hours later, the potato is in my belly.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr pursued animated potatoes, captured them with a knife, stuffed them into a bag, and later consumed one, describing it as more filling than a captured rat. Zephyr later participated in the infiltration of the Black Earth Cult encampment and observed the failed bluff by Calmer.
source_quote: Bouncing potatoes,” I shout to Seqoia and run after them... I grab one, and the other two pause as if angry... I stab the one in my hand... The potato is in my belly. And I feel blessed.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, "You served me well, potato. And you were certainly more filling than that rat I caught in that prison."
source_quote: "You served me well, potato. And you were certainly more filling than that rat I caught in that prison."

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia delivered a barrel of mead to the Honey Tavern Inn and interacted with Glannon, who offered a keg of magical mead that enhances charisma and persuasion. Zinnia suspected mockery but accepted the gift. Zinnia later observed and reacted to clues about the Black Earth Cult with a momentary flash of pleasure when the trail became clear.
source_quote: You found it? Yes. He rolls the barrel behind the bar, and takes out a keg, 'Here’s my fine keg of mead... The magic in the mead will help when you need to interact with people and persuade them.'

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a combatant who delivers a flurry of blows against the bandits, contributing significantly to their rapid elimination during the battle.
source_quote: Zinnia follows, just laying into the bandits with some serious force. Flurry of blows, he calls it, multiple attacks, and the bandits are dropping like flies.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is inscrutable but reveals a momentary flash of pleasure when hearing about the Black Earth Cult and the box Lareth wants.
source_quote: I look at Zinnia, and although he is inscrutable, even his eyes reveal a momentary flash of pleasure.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia shows a momentary flash of pleasure upon hearing about the Black Earth Cult.
source_quote: I look at Zinnia, and although he is inscrutable, even his eyes reveal a momentary flash of pleasure.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia thanked Glannon.
source_quote: I thank him.

subject: animated broccoli
fact: An enchanted vegetable that became animated and fled the feast, heading toward the apothecary. It was eventually struck with a spell and collapsed into a dark green substance, suggesting it was a vessel or byproduct of the Black Earth Cult’s magic.
source_quote: It took off like a shot towards the apothecary... I pick up the 'broccoli' now just a very dark green something...

subject: animated broccoli
fact: The animated broccoli took off toward the apothecary, and was later reduced to a very dark green something after being struck.
source_quote: It took off like a shot towards the apothecary, that place with all the magical potions and stuff. I pick up the "broccoli" now just a very dark green something and go back to the honey tavern.

subject: animated potatoes
fact: Animated potatoes were chased, grabbed, stabbed, and later consumed in a honey-glazed forest stew.
source_quote: I grab one, and the other two pause as if angry. So I take my knife and stab the one in my hand. And a few hours later, the potato is in my belly. And I feel blessed. The honey-glazed forest stew feels like a blessing indeed.

subject: animated potatoes
fact: Three animated potatoes that escaped the feast, causing chaos in the village. One was stabbed and consumed by Zephyr, while the others were captured and bagged. Their animation suggests the cult’s ability to imbue mundane objects with life.
source_quote: Bouncing potatoes... I grab one, and the other two pause as if angry... I stab the one in my hand... The potato is in my belly.

subject: barrel
fact: Zinnia carries a barrel to the Honey Tavern Inn.
source_quote: With the barrel over my shoulder I arrive at the Honey Tavern Inn.

subject: barrels
fact: The barrels in the encampment are the same ones that were taken from the caravan and are now held by the cult.
source_quote: Inside the walls is a temple to some god, a weird stone statue, as well the barrels that we are looking for.

subject: dark green substance
fact: The collapsed broccoli became a very dark green something.
source_quote: I pick up the “broccoli” now just a very dark green something

subject: glowing runes
fact: Faintly glowing magical runes etched into rocks at the caravan attack site, indicating the use of high-level enchantment or ritual magic. Their presence confirmed the attack was not banditry but the work of the Black Earth Cult.
source_quote: faintly glowing runes etched into the rocks... I shout, 'Magic.'

subject: honey jars
fact: Honey jars were scattered at the caravan site, indicating the stolen cargo.
source_quote: The site is littered with overturned wagons, broken barrels, and scattered honey jars.

subject: keg of mead
fact: Glannon gives Zinnia a keg of mead with magical properties.
source_quote: Here’s my fine keg of mead.

subject: keg of mead
fact: The magic in the mead helps with persuasion and attracting attention.
source_quote: The magic in the mead will help when you need to interact with people and persuade them.

subject: magical mead keg
fact: A keg of mead imbued with magic that enhances charisma, persuasion, and the ability to 'turn heads' or 'convince merchants.' Offered by Glannon at the Honey Tavern Inn as a tool for social manipulation, possibly linked to the cult’s broader enchantment practices.
source_quote: Here’s my fine keg of mead... The magic in the mead will help when you need to interact with people and persuade them.

subject: mud men
fact: Mud men were summoned beside Calmer and exploded upon defeat, creating area-of-effect immobilization.
source_quote: Suddenly two muddy creatures appear right beside Calmer. Mud men. ... When these mud men go down, they kind of explode, make it so you can’t move.

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: stone golem
fact: The stone golem is large, tough, resistant to non-magical attacks, and was summoned by Thalsor during the battle.
source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam! – it comes alive. Stone Golem, they call it. Big, tough, and resistant to everything but magical attacks.

subject: stone object
fact: A mysterious stone object, possibly a focus or artifact, is tapped by Thalsor to summon the stone golem. It is integral to his ability to deploy powerful constructs.
source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam! – it comes alive.

subject: stone staff
fact: Thalsor wields a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals, which channels his magic and causes runes on the cavern walls to flare with ominous light.
source_quote: his hands tightening around a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals... the runes on the walls flare with an ominous light.

subject: stone staff with jagged crystals
fact: Thalsor wields a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals, which activates runes on the walls during combat.
source_quote: I watch as he steps forward, his hands tightening around a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals.

subject: stone-studded leather armor
fact: The cultists wear stone-studded leather armor and carry stone weapons.
source_quote: The guardian are wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons.

subject: stone weapons
fact: The cultists carry stone weapons, indicating their connection to the Black Earth Cult and the Earth Mother.
source_quote: The guardian are wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons.

subject: Black Earth Cult's identity
fact: The party suspects the Black Earth Cult is responsible for the caravan attack and may possess the box Lareth wants.
source_quote: This might be the clue and evidence we need. It certainly is who Lareth wants us to kill, and they might have this box that Lareth wants.

subject: Lareth’s target
fact: Lareth has tasked the party with identifying and eliminating the Black Earth Cult, believed to be responsible for the caravan attack and possibly possessing a box he desires. The cult’s use of stone weapons and chanting confirms they are the intended target, though their full motives remain unclear.
source_quote: This might be the clue and evidence we need. It certainly is who Lareth wants us to kill, and they might have this box that Lareth wants.

subject: mysterious falling rocks
fact: The party nearly got crushed by falling rocks while following the trail to the cult encampment. Though no culprits were found, the timing suggests possible manipulation by the cult to deter pursuers, hinting at deeper earth-based magic or sentience.
source_quote: We almost get crushed by falling rocks... I am worried that the stones were not an accident, but we find nothing.

subject: Palsmarie Clee's presence
fact: It is unclear whether Palsmarie Clee walked into the Inn or was always there.
source_quote: Has she walked into the Inn, or was she always there?

subject: Thalsor’s true identity
fact: Thalsor’s name and origins are uncertain — referred to as 'whatever his name is' — suggesting he may be an alias or a figure with hidden history.
source_quote: This druid, Thalsor, whatever his name is...

subject: the honey
fact: The honey is the central object of Thalsor’s obsession and the reason for his hostility. He refuses to surrender it and offers to trade instead, suggesting deeper lore or magical significance.
source_quote: That honey now belongs to the Black Earth Temple... Offers to trade, anything but giving up the honey.

subject: The identity of the attackers
fact: The identity of the attackers is unknown, though Palsmarie Clee suspects they are not bandits.
source_quote: I don’t know. Gnonsbim says they are bandits. I don’t think so.

subject: The location of the Black Earth Temple
fact: The exact location of the Black Earth Temple is not yet known, though the encampment in the Kron Hills is suspected.
source_quote: It’s built into a shallow cave on a rocky outcrop in the Kron Hills.

subject: The nature of the Stone Golem
fact: The nature and origin of the Stone Golem conjured by Thalsor are unexplained.
source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam – it comes alive. Stone Golem, they call it.

subject: The origin of the animated vegetables
fact: The origin of the animated broccoli and potatoes is unexplained.
source_quote: some of the ingredients were animated and they rushed into the village.

subject: the stone golem’s origin
fact: The stone golem’s creation via a simple stone tap implies it may be bound, ancient, or magically linked to the location or Thalsor’s power source — its true nature is unexplained.
source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam! – it comes alive.
